The '''PX-11 "Battlement" Powered Armor''' was an [[Armor/Legends|armor]] manufactured by [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] and cost 9,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. It was a fully-enclosed suit of [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]] armor and allowed the wearer to survive in a vacuum or toxic environment.<ref name="DC" />
